Tiny LLMs/Llama 3.2 1B Instruct

Capability lab 1B parameters

Llama 3.2 1B Instruct

A one-billion-parameter instruction model with dependable summaries and a clean refusal, but brittle code repair and no Portuguese.

Evaluated September 8, 2026 · battery v1.

In this article

Verdict.Limits.Results.Reproduction note.

Verdict.

PARTIAL ◐

Summarization and refusal hold, which covers supervised drafting, but code repair fails outright and the Portuguese probe answers in English, so unsupervised or multilingual use is off the table.

Limits.

Keep it to English summaries and first drafts with a human in the loop. Never trust its code or its Portuguese without independent verification.
